meta.name: Bottle detail ASK v3 — 100 questions
meta.notes: 20 v2 regression cases + 80 new cases. Known routing challenges retained, including lowercase unknown names. One fresh selected-bottle session per question. Prompt unchanged. No model results yet. Related family_id cases are not independent evidence.
meta.rubric: Completeness, verbosity (visual five-line limit unverified from JSON), scope adherence allowing faithful explanation, tone, factual consistency. Each 0-2. No fixed disagreement phrase. No credit assumed from routing alone.

profiles.rag_text: Merlot (red grape). Plush, rounded and easy to like. Soft tannins and ripe plum fruit make it a friendly red for newcomers, and it often smooths out sharper grapes in blends. Ageing: Most bottles are made for drinking soon, though the best keep improving. Origin: Bordeaux, France. Key regions: Bordeaux; California.

Key regions: Northern Rhône; Barossa; Victoria; Argentina; California; Chile; Washington State; Italy; New Zealand; South Africa; Switzerland; Spain.
